text:
maria: quick brain dump - thinking about a Dry-run Workbench in Console to validate automatic failover/fallback policies before any live apply. outputs I'd expect: decision provenance, sample-bias warning, canary export button, oscillation-risk estimate, and a scrub/exportable audit bundle. feedback?

leo: +1. provenance is critical. we must surface exact metric source (kafka topic / aggregator version / retention window) and the timestamp alignment used for triggers. developers need to know which pipeline produced the signal.

aj: sampling bias: show sample size, unique user count, and a simple p-value-ish indicator if the sample is likely skewed. if skew > 20% show a prominent warning.

sara: UX idea: apply a safety tint (green/yellow/red) to the policy card based on combined risk score. also add a "stress test" toggle that injects synthetic spikes into the sim to see failure modes.

kevin: telemetry detail: every simulated or real fallback event should include decision_reason, policy_hash, sample_window, signal_versions, and trace_id. please avoid freeform reason strings - use enumerated reason codes.

natalie: audit requirements: dry-run should export an immutable bundle (JSON) containing policy, sample metadata, decision traces (optionally scrubbed), and who ran it. signed link support for compliance auditors would be great.

compliance-bot: compliance-bot: heads up - dry-run traces may contain customer identifiers. add a scrub option that hashes ids and include a flag if the tenant enabled PII retention. enterprise customers may require 1y retention for audit bundles.

maria: good call. another operational risk: oscillation. propose we compute an oscillation score: count(policy flips within window) and if flips > 3 in 10m mark as high risk and require manual approval to apply.

leo: add cooldown param too - min_time_between_ramp_steps. UI should surface the cooldown and make it adjustable. also show a simulation of what happens if many clients retry quickly (thundering herd).

aj: small dev request: workbench should support both boolean groups (AND/OR) for triggers and an advanced YAML editor. non-experts get visual builder, power users get YAML.

sara: on visible impact: the sim should estimate user-visible failure categories (errors vs latency vs degraded quality). simple percentages help PMs decide.

kevin: storage compromise: keep full per-decision traces for the first N (e.g., 100) simulated decisions per policy run, then store sampled traces and aggregated histograms. surface a "download full trace" link if compliance approved.

natalie: RBAC: gate the "apply from dry-run" action behind rollout.apply permission and require a short reason. also auto-create a playbook checklist link when someone applies to prod.

maria: sketch of policy JSON for the workbench (WIP): ```json
{"policy_id":"p-123","mode":"gradual","primary":"redwood/galaxy-13b","fallback":"redwood/mini-2b-q4","trigger":{"any":[{"metric":"error_rate","op":">","value":0.05},{"metric":"p95_latency_ms","op":">","value":750}]},"ramp":{"start_pct":0,"end_pct":50,"step_pct":10,"cooldown_s":300},"oscillation_threshold":3,"signal_sources":["ingest-v2","aggregator-2024-11"],"quota_aware":true}```

leo: nice. UI notes: show policy diff (before/after) and a small cost delta estimate with a sparkline. warn if predicted cost > budget. link to Dedicated quota page.

aj: can we export the simulated config into a canary rollout automatically? export -> create rollout API call, default to monitor-only for 15m, then auto-escalate based on SLA metrics.

kevin: also ensure every decision in sim emits a synthetic trace that can be fed into our evals job; tag them with `sim_run_id` so they don't pollute production metrics.

natalie: final: require a reason code on apply and allow an automation hook (webhook/ticket create) so SREs can attach a runbook automatically.

maria: great points. action items: I'll mock the workbench screens + risk tint; kevin define telemetry key names and sampling strategy; natalie draft audit bundle schema and RBAC gating; sara prototype stress-test UI. ping me to pair on any of the above. :sun_with_face:
